free_tier.stated: No free tier. Step Plan is a paid subscription with four Credit tiers (Flash Mini USD 6.99, Plus USD 9.99, Pro USD 29, Max USD 99 per month); USD 1 is about 7M Credits. Monthly Credits are cleared at month end and do not roll over.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: a subscription meters usage, not objects

retention.stated: not applicable: the vendor serves the inference; no caller-stored bytes

egress.terms: not applicable: the vendor serves the inference

tooling: OpenAI SDK at /step_plan/v1 and Anthropic SDK at /step_plan; Claude Code, OpenClaw, Trae and Cursor are named
chaining: the monthly Credit allowance is spent only through the Step Plan base URL; the standard API channel has a separate quota and a successful call there does not spend Step Plan Credits

limits.value: 400M to 40,000M Credits per month by tier
monthly Credits cleared at month end; no rollover

identity_cost.detail: a StepFun account plus a paid subscription (Stripe card or account balance); no free route remains, and the vendor closed new free trials

reliability_note: Step Plan purchase quotas are released in limited daily batches; tiers can show out of stock

evidence.proved: Step Plan has four paid tiers starting at USD 6.99 per month

evidence.quote: No. Monthly-allowance Credits are cleared at the end of the month and do not carry over to the next cycle.
evidence.proved: monthly Credits do not roll over

evidence.quote: All requests uniformly use the `/step_plan/v1/...` path prefix, and the domain name is fixed as `https://api.stepfun.ai`.
evidence.proved: the dedicated OpenAI and Anthropic base URLs are documented

notes: Paid-only. The reasoning-api doc URL is the manifest's page and is captured; the overview.md page supplies the price ladder because the reasoning page links to it.
